svg.title: Vyomaraj AI Agent OS v2.1 — Technical Master Architecture
svg.desc: Owner-controlled provider-neutral AI federation with ShriYantra foundation, Vyomaraj and Jarvis peers, agent and tool fabrics, knowledge and monetization, Kuber finance, security and gated disaster recovery. Portrait artwork is maintained in a separate brand edition.
